confidence_notes: I ran three web searches: one for the RBA rate and two for Trinidad prices. The RBA result gave 0.6720 USD per AUD for 2026-11-18. Trinidad-specific food and drink prices are sparse, dated and conflicting. The usable figures came from travel-guide and aggregator sites: a Tripbase Trinidad budget page (about $5 budget meal, $15 mid-range meal, $1 coffee, $2 beer, $4 cocktail), plus Cuba-wide blog ranges for beer, meals and mojitos. I found no direct glass-of-wine price, so I based wine on cocktail and beer relationships and on bottle prices of roughly $10-18. Tourist-facing paladares in Trinidad often charge more than the aggregates suggest, and prices are quoted in both USD and CUP. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates, not from listings. Casas particulares dominate, so registered hostels and 3-star hotels are scarce and the hostel anchors are especially uncertain. The July 2026 pricing window is not verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cuba-wide tourist pricing, anchored on the Trinidad budget guide, with casa particular-style accommodation levels and Caribbean tourist-town comparisons such as Viñales and Cienfuegos.
